topics.summary: I could not find a published national monthly series for 일반건강검진 수검. 건강검진통계연보, the NHIS press releases and the data.go.kr files are annual only, and the KOSIS table list would not load. So the recommended vector is my own estimate, not a published figure. It is fitted to NHIS cumulative figures: 2019 Jan-Mar was 10.1% of annual 수검, Jan-Apr 17.6% and Jan-Oct 67.5%; 2026 Jan-Jun was about 37% (provisional). Its month-by-month shape comes from the only large national monthly series I found, KNCSP gastric endoscopy 2013-16 (Dec 19.7-20.1%, Q4 41.4-42.2%). I checked it against NHIS cohort seasons (Sep-Nov 29.4%, Dec-Feb 25.3%) and monthly counts from NHIS 일산병원. Recommended Jan..Dec: .020 .035 .055 .075 .085 .080 .080 .080 .065 .100 .125 .200 (Q4 42.5%, Dec 20%). The year-end peak is structural (Dec 31 deadline, 사업장 과태료) and held steady 2013-14 vs 2015-16, so use the vector for all years 2027-2031. For 2027, multiply Apr-Dec by a launch ramp and rescale so the months add to 250k; with my example ramp, Dec is about 27% of 2027 volume. Private 종합검진 (일산병원 종합검진센터 2018-19) is much flatter: Q4 about 30%, Dec about 8%. Use that shape for paid 종합검진 bookings. Partner centers are full in December, so a booking platform's December share will likely be lower than the national one. For new-service ramp I found no monthly booking data for 착한의사, 굿닥, 똑닥 or 인피니티케어, so the ramp multipliers are assumptions.

items.label: 일반건강검진 수검 monthly share Jan..Dec — recommended national allocation vector
items.derivation: DERIVED (no published national monthly 일반검진 series). Step 1, fixed anchors from NHIS cumulative 수검률 divided by the final annual rate: 2019 Jan-Mar 7.49/74.1=10.1%; Jan-Apr (8.19+4.87)/74.1=17.6%; Jan-Oct 50/74.1=67.5%, so Nov-Dec=32.5%. 2026 H1 28.1/75.4=37.3% (provisional). Step 2, monthly shape within the anchor blocks from the KNCSP gastric-endoscopy monthly counts (2013-14 and 2015-16, national), with January lowered toward the 일산병원 pattern (검진표 is mailed in January). Step 3, cross-checks for the recommended vector: Q1 11.0% (anchor 10.1); Jan-Oct 67.5% (anchor 67.5); H1 35.0% (between the 2019-implied value and the 2026 snapshot 37.3; KNCSP 36.9); Q4 42.5% (KNCSP 41.4-42.2); Dec 20.0% (KNCSP 19.7-20.1); Sep-Nov 29.0% (NHIS cohort 29.4); Dec-Feb 25.5% (cohort 25.3); Mar-May 21.5% (cohort 22.6); Jun-Aug 24.0% (cohort 22.7). Sep is set low because of the 추석 dip seen in both KNCSP and 일산병원 data. Stability check with prior periods: KNCSP 2013-14 vs 2015-16 gave Q4 41.4% vs 42.2%, Jan-Oct 68.3% vs 67.8%, Dec 20.1% vs 19.7%. 일산병원 일반검진 2018 vs 2019 gave Q4 38.4% vs 33.4% (a single site with capacity limits, so flatter). low = flattest observed shape (일산병원 일반검진 2019, computed from the monthly counts). high = the most December-concentrated national series (KNCSP 2013-14, computed). The KNCSP 2015-16 shares were [0.0422,0.0444,0.0838,0.0752,0.0686,0.0553,0.0658,0.0765,0.0664,0.1000,0.1250,0.1969]. Use for all model years 2027-2031, measured by exam month, not booking month.

A search snippet said about 38% of checkups fall after October, attributed to NHIS; I could not verify it in the NHIS 건강검진 안내 PDFs, so it is excluded.

The national H1 anchor (2026 2/4분기 28.1%) is provisional and may be understated by claim lag, or distorted by how 이월 checkups are counted. Past quarterly snapshots on the NHIS 경영공시 page (e.g., 2025 3/4분기) could not be retrieved (web.archive.org blocked).

The KNCSP monthly shape is from gastric endoscopy 2013-2016, not 일반검진, and predates 2023. Cancer and general checkups usually happen together, but the January-April months differ from the 2019 일반검진 anchors (KNCSP Jan-Apr 23.5% vs 일반검진 17.6%).

Private 종합검진 seasonality rests on one NHIS-run hospital (일산병원) for 2018-2019. Its 2020-2024 yearbook pages show only annual totals. I found no DART filing or large private center (KMI, 하나로, 강북삼성) disclosing monthly volumes.

All vectors are by exam month. The booking-to-exam lead time (typically weeks) and partner-center December slot capacity are unsourced and should be set from partner contracts.
COVID years (2020-2022, with deadlines extended to the next June) distort monthly patterns; the NHIS cohort seasonal split (2013-2022) includes them.

verdicts.note: Source checks all passed. KNCSP Table 1 (PMC7791358) was checked through the Europe PMC full text for the same PMCID, because the PMC page returned a reCAPTCHA. Monthly counts, totals (9,892,812 / 11,642,410) and Q4 41.39% / 42.19% match. The KNCSP 2015-16 and 2013-14 share vectors, Jan-Oct 68.3/67.8, Dec 20.1/19.7 and H1 36.9 all recompute. The 일산 2019 counts match. The 2019 anchors match their sources: 메디칼업저버 (7.49%, April gap 4.87%p, 2020 April 8.19%), 쿠키뉴스 (50% through October) and the NHIS 2022 연보 (74.1%). The 2026 figure is on the NHIS 경영공시 page, 28.1% at 6/30, marked 미확정. Four problems. (1) Internal inconsistency: Step 1 calls the anchors fixed, but the recommended vector gives Q1 11.0% against the 10.1% anchor and Jan-Apr 18.5% against 17.6%. The Jan-Apr miss is not disclosed. The corrected vector meets every 2019 anchor exactly (Q1 10.1, Jan-Apr 17.6, Jan-Oct 67.5) and keeps Dec 20.0%, Q4 42.4% and H1 34.7%. The months change by less than 1pp each. (2) The cohort fall share is 29.3%, not 29.4%. (3) low and high are not bounds on each month. The low vector (일산 2019) is above recommended in Feb-Sep, the high vector (KNCSP 2013-14) is below recommended in May-Nov, and low exceeds high in 8 of 12 months. Relabel them as alternative shapes (flat vs concentrated scenarios). Also, 일산 is excluded from the Q4 range as capacity-limited but used here as low, which is inconsistent. (4) Anchor bias: dividing a cumulative rate by the final rate gives a count share only if the 대상자 denominator stays the same. The cited 쿠키뉴스 data show it does not. In 2020 the October denominator was 20,562,174 against 21,446천 final, so the count share through October was 61.8%, while 43.7/67.8 gives 64.5%. If 2019 behaved the same way, Jan-Oct would be about 64.7%, Nov-Dec about 35% and Q4 about 45%, so the vector may understate year-end concentration. Treat that as a sensitivity. The 'Dec 31 deadline / 사업장 과태료' reason has no source in the research. 뉴시스 (2023-12-01, https://www.newsis.com/view/NISX20231201_0002543384) confirms 산업안전보건법 제129조 exposure: 사업주 up to 1,000만원 and 근로자 up to 300만원. The per-person amounts differ between secondary sources.

KNCSP Q4 41.39% / 42.19% verified in the Europe PMC full text of PMC7791358. 시사저널 (2025-06-19) states '전체 건강검진자의 약 40%가 4분기에 집중되며, 특히 12월에 가장 많이'. It cites no data source ('알려져 있다'), as the research says. 쿠키뉴스: 2019 through October 50%, verified. NHIS 2022 연보 PDF: 2019 74.1%, verified. The arithmetic is right (1-50/74.1=32.5%, +10% October = 42.5%). Caveat: the denominator bias described under checkup_month_share would push the 2019-implied Q4 to about 45%. Consider raising high from 0.44 to 0.45.

Every input figure is verified. 메디칼업저버 2020-06-01: 2019 March 7.49%; '4월에 와서는 ... 일반검진은 4.87%P' gap; 2020 April 8.19%. 쿠키뉴스 2020-12-18: 898만2255 of 2056만2174, 43.7%; 2019 same period 50%. NHIS 경영공시: 2026 2/4분기 28.1%, 2025 75.4%, 2024 75.6%, with a note that 2025-26 are 미확정. 검진비 지급: 2025 23,827억, 2026 Jan-Jun 10,749억. NHIS 2024 연보 PDF: 2020-2024 rates 67.8/74.2/75.4/75.9/75.6. The ratio arithmetic is correct (0.101, 0.176, 0.675, 0.373, 0.372, 0.645, 0.451). Logic error: the label says share of annual 수검 (a count share), but a ratio of rates equals a count share only when the 대상자 denominator is constant. The research's own 2020 source shows it grows during the year. 20,562,174 at October against 21,446천 final is a factor of 0.959, so the true count share through October 2020 was 8,982,255/14,545천 = 61.8%, not 64.5%. The corrected values apply the same 0.959 factor to the 2019 anchors. This is my assumption: the 2019 in-year denominator growth is not published. Treat the original values as upper bounds. The 2026 H1 value is left at 0.373, because denominator growth pushes it up while claim lag pushes it down, by unknown amounts.

Checked in the Europe PMC full text of PMC12429781 (J Clin Med, 2025-08-23, NHIS-2024-02-387). The paper gives seasonal counts separately for men (603,546 / 610,036 / 831,135 / 675,495; n=2,720,212) and women (642,450 / 640,302 / 785,049 / 719,238; n=2,787,039). The research's totals (1,245,996 / 1,250,338 / 1,616,184 / 1,394,733 of 5,507,251) are sums of the two, so they are a derivation, not a quoted table value. Fall = 1,616,184/5,507,251 = 0.2935, which rounds to 29.3%, not 29.4%. The data are an 8% random sample of adults aged 40+ who had at least one screening in 2013-2022, not all screenings. Seasons: Mar-May, Jun-Aug, Sep-Nov, Dec-Feb.

Verified from the 일산병원 yearbook pages. The 2019 page shows 일반검진 monthly counts 988 ... 8,261 (total 67,350, with the 2018 total 58,523). The 2018 page shows 514 ... 7,605 (total 58,523). Recomputed shares match: 2019 Q1 14.8%, H1 40.1%, Q4 33.4%, Dec 12.3%; 2018 Q1 13.4%, H1 35.4%, Q4 38.4%, Dec 13.0%. Notes: 'low = 2018' is another year's shape, not a bound (2018 is above 2019 in Aug-Dec). The explanation that January is low because 검진표 is issued then is an unsourced inference. I did not verify that the 2020-2024 yearbooks show annual totals only.

종합검진 counts verified: 2019 364 ... 711 (total 8,556) and 2018 328 ... 648 (total 8,259). The averaged vector recomputes exactly, as do Q4 30.3/29.5, Dec 7.8/8.3 and H1 41.6/41.7. 경향신문 2020-07-24 verified: '대개 10~12월에 검진 인원이 몰리는', and 건협 reported 2020 H1 일반검진 수검자 -22.6%. 시사저널's summer off-season claim is verified. Corrections to supporting sources: the Himedi blog (2025-10-24) does not literally say December is the busiest booking month. It says demand 'skyrockets every winter' and that employees book in December to use expiring company benefits. Himedi also serves foreign or medical-tourist patients, so it is weak evidence for domestic bookings. low (2018) and high (2019) are year shapes, not bounds. Relying on one public hospital for 2018-19 is disclosed.

Labeled as an assumption, which is correct. The milestone sources are verified. 머니투데이 2024-08-14: '160만명의 유저를 시작으로 1년 여 만에 90여개의 기업(B2B) 고객사를 확보', plus the 굿닥 고객전용 검진예약 launch. 서울신문 2025-07-31: B2B CAGR 165% over 3 years, 185만 users. 벤처스퀘어 2021-11-22: 70만 users, 130 hospitals, about 1,000+ 검진상품, 60억원. 아시아타임즈 2022-05-06: launched 2017-04, 730만 members, 2,600만 visits, 13,000+ hospitals. None of these give monthly ramp data, as the research states.

With the original vector, the arithmetic is correct: weights sum to 0.735, monthly counts are 6,378 ... 68,027, and Dec is 27.21%. Arithmetic error in the side statement: seasonality-only Apr-Dec sums to 0.89, not 0.925, so Apr = 8.4% (not 8.1%) and Dec = 22.5% (not 21.6%). The corrected allocation uses the anchor-consistent checkup_month_share vector: weights sum to 0.7407 and Dec is 27.0%. LEGAL-STRUCTURE FLAG: the allocation is safe as a volume driver only. Do not turn it into revenue as a per-booking commission from 검진기관. 의료법 제27조 제3항 bans for-profit patient 소개·알선·유인. In 대법원 2018도20928 (2019-04-25, https://law.go.kr/LSW/precInfoP.do?precSeq=207141), a platform that sold hospital procedure coupons and took 15-20% commissions was held to go beyond 의료광고 into illegal 알선. The penalty (3년 이하 징역 / 3천만원 이하 벌금) came from a search summary; I did not check it against the statute text. National 일반건강검진 is paid by NHIS at no cost to examinees, so these bookings carry no fee a platform can lawfully take. Revenue lines should use employer B2B contracts, flat advertising or SaaS fees not tied to volume, or paid 종합검진 contracted with the payer. Also, a 27% December share in the launch year needs a check against partner December capacity.

Verified in the NHIS 2024 건강검진 통계연보 press release PDF (배포 2025-12-30, 보도 2025-12-31). Table '2024년 시도별 일반건강검진 대상 및 수검현황' shows 계 23,181,731 / 17,517,365 / 75.6%. The derivations are correct: 250,000/17,517,365 = 1.43%, and 0.20 × 17.5M = 3.50M. Context caveat: most of the 250k 예약 target may be paid 종합검진 rather than 일반검진, so the 1.43% is not a like-for-like penetration figure.

topics.summary: Demand is large and growing. 65+ share is 20.3% (KOSTAT 2025). 장기요양 인정자 numbered 1,235,045 in 2025 (+6%/yr, NHIS), equal to 11.7% of 65+ in 2024 (NABO). 재가급여 paid 10.19조 through 23,373 재가기관 (2025 연보). 사적 간병비 is about 10조/yr (MOHW, 2022). Legal structure: 노인장기요양보험법 §35⑥ bans anyone from referring or inducing 수급자 to a 기관 for profit in exchange for money or other benefits (2년/2천만원, §67). Courts treated per-patient or percentage fees as illegal 알선 under 의료법 §27③ (대법 2018도20928, 15-20% commission), but a flat ad fee not tied to patient volume was not (헌재 2017헌마327). A per-match 소개료 from 방문요양센터 or 요양병원 is therefore high-risk. Recommendation: a flat monthly 파트너 이용료 per center (listing, AI상담 routing, SaaS), not tied to referrals or matches. Base fee 30만원/월 (range 15-50만). Benchmarks: ERP costs 1.1만원/월, and a center with 30 수급자 earns about 5.2억/yr. Base drivers: care_target_rate 1.0% of members/yr, match 35%, 3 leads per center per month, 12-month ramp from a July 2027 start. Base revenue (억원): 2027 0.60, 2028 7.98, 2029 23.27, 2030 47.15, 2031 81.65. Low 0.13 to 20.4; high 1.68 to 204. All rates, fees and revenues are my derivations. There is no public benchmark for match rate or center ad fees, and 2031 base implies about 2,777 partner centers (about 12% of 재가기관). 요양병원 간병비 급여화 (500 hospitals by 2030) shrinks the private 간병 matching pool, so lead with 방문요양/주야간보호 partners.

items.recommended: Flat monthly 파트너 이용료 per center (listing/ads + AI상담 routing + SaaS tools), fixed by tier (e.g., region or listing size), NOT tied to number of leads, matches, 수급자 or % of 급여비. No per-case 소개료 and no revenue share. Never waive or discount 본인부담금. For 간병 (non-LTC) supply, partner only with registered 직업소개사업자 and charge them the same flat fee.
items.derivation: (1) 노인장기요양보험법 §35⑥ bans anyone from referring, brokering or inducing 수급자 to a 기관 for profit by offering money or other benefits. §35⑤ bans for-profit waiver or discount of 본인일부부담금. Violation is punishable by up to 2 years or 2천만원 under §67. The penalty was confirmed via the 2011 입법예고 report and a statute-database snippet, and should be re-verified on law.go.kr. A per-match fee paid by a 방문요양센터 to the platform is the textbook form of paying for a referral. (2) 의료법 §27③ covers 요양병원 and other medical partners. 대법원 2018도20928 upheld a conviction where a site took 15-20% of treatment fees. 헌재 2017헌마327 treated a monthly ad fee set by hospital size, not patients, as a legitimate ad cost. So: flat = defensible, variable per patient = illegal. (3) Under 직업안정법, per-placement 간병 fees are regulated 직업소개 fees: up to 30% from 구인자 and 1% from 구직자. Insurers since Q4 2024 recognize only platforms registered as 직업소개사업. Inference: the flat-fee structure is lower-risk but not a safe harbor. Get a written legal opinion or MOHW 질의회신 before launch, and avoid 'guaranteed N leads' clauses.

verdicts.note: I re-opened all four sources and they check out. KOSTAT (2025-09-29) says 65+ is 20.3%. The 10.51M head count is not in the fetched page, but a search summary of the same release gives 1,051만4천명. NHIS 경영공시 shows 인정자 1,165,030 (2024) and 1,235,045 (2025), which is +6.0%. NABO Focus 113 (2025-06-17) PDF text says 65+ 대비 인정자 비율 went from 7.2% (2015) to 11.7% (2024). MOHW 노인실태조사 (2024-10-17) gives 18.6% / 47.2% / 81.4% / 30.7%. These are multiple-response shares, so it is not '81.4% of care is from family'. Problem 1, arithmetic: the derivation's own steps do not support the high case. 1.235M x 2.5 / 30M = 10.3% of adults. Times 30-40% gives 3-4%, and times the 40% routing share gives 1.2-1.6%, not 2.0%. Low (3-4% x 15% = 0.45-0.6%) and base (0.9-1.2%) are consistent. Problem 2, logic: counting 2.5 relatives per elder double-counts leads when several relatives are members, since each care event yields at most one contract. That inflates leads relative to matches. The 2.5 multiplier and the 30M adult denominator are unsourced assumptions.

   - The seoulhr.com page does not contain the 10-15% agency fee. I checked the page for 수수료 and percent signs and found none, so the 22-39만원 cross-check is unsupported.
   - caredochome.co.kr still returns 403. A search result shows it is a consumer 지인추천 reward (2만 + 5만 + 30만 + 100만), not a B2B fee benchmark.

3. **care_fee_structure:** the 2018도20928 amount is 6억 805만원 (about 6.08억), not 6.018억.

**Legal checks**
- **Verified:** §35⑥ verbatim, the 2011 입법예고 penalty (2년/2천만원), 2017헌마327 versus 2018도20928, the 직업소개 fee caps (1% / 30%) and the insurer 직업소개사업 requirement.

Seasonality: 국가데이터처 온라인쇼핑동향 has no separate 건강기능식품 series. The nearest proxy is 음·식료품 (monthly, 2023.1–2026.7, latest release 2026-09-01). I removed the trend with a centered 12-month moving average and rescaled older data to the latest revision. The seasonal swing is small, from 0.94 (Feb) to 1.08 (Sep). Peaks come in Jan (before 설) and Sep (추석), with a smaller one in May (가정의 달). Coupang Ads also reports that 건강식품 sales cluster in Mar–May and Aug–Sep. Gift-heavy 농축수산물 swings more (Jan and Sep about 1.19), so treat it as the upper bound if 홍삼/gift sets make up a big share. 스포츠·레저 is weak in Jan–Feb (about 0.76).

Ramp: I found no public month-by-month GMV for the first 6 months of any Korean health mall. Available data points: 캐시딜 was at about 10억 a month by month 9 and 30억 by month 14 (driven by traffic and catalog growth); 닥터다이어리 grew 13% or more per month in 2021; 필리 claimed 20–30% monthly growth. So I built the 6-month ramp from repurchase-retention curves applied to a steady inflow of first-time buyers, plus an optional slower start while members become aware of the mall. Sources: a Korean food-subscription cohort (60/42/25% at months 1–3) and Recharge supplement data (86.6/57.6/33.8% at orders 2–4). This gives 0.28 → 0.92 by month 6, and repurchases make up 62–71% of steady-state revenue.

Recommendation: keep the annual totals as they are. Spread them across months with the mild index. It barely changes the H2 share (50.2% vs 50.0% if flat), but it puts Sep 2027 (추석 9/15, launch month 3) about 8% above average. Flat allocation is acceptable if simplicity matters more.

Each curve also run with a first-buyer awareness ramp a = 0.70/0.85/0.95/1/1/1: A gives 0.202/0.420/0.602/0.735/0.824/0.881, B gives 0.266/0.482/0.666/0.798/0.879/0.929. verdicts.note: All sources opened again. Recharge (Jul 2026, updated Aug 2026; about 1,800 brands, Jul 2025-Jun 2026) confirms 86.6% (1st reorder), 57.6% (2nd), 33.8% (3rd), 9.8% (6th) and 1.4% (12th). These are cumulative order-sequence retention of first-time SUBSCRIBERS, so mapping them to orders 2/3/4/7/13 is correct. Laplace (2025-09-02, an anonymized 식품 구독 brand) confirms 60/42/25% at months 1-3. 캐시딜 (seller guide, 2024-11-28) confirms launch Apr 2023, 연 120억 수준 at Dec 2023 and 월 30억 at May 2024. Reading 연 120억 as about 10억 a month at month 9 is an interpretation of a run rate. 닥터다이어리 (2021-08-27) confirms 월평균 13% 이상, but the article does not say which metric. The 필리 profile is dated 2022.07.13, not undated, and its 20~30% monthly growth has no metric either. Both are pre-2023, and startup revenue growth is a weak cross-check for a per-member ramp. I recomputed the derivation: sums are 3.469 (A) and 2.638 (B). The four cases for months 1-6 match to ±0.001 (A 0.288/0.538/0.704/0.801/0.866/0.909; B 0.379/0.607/0.766/0.861/0.917/0.951; A with awareness 0.202/0.420/0.602/0.735/0.824/0.881; B with awareness 0.265/0.481/0.665/0.797/0.878/0.927). Their average rounds to 0.28/0.51/0.68/0.80/0.87/0.92, and the low/high vectors match. ERROR 1: 'month 8 onward is 1.0' is wrong. The 4-case average for months 7-12 is 0.946/0.965/0.977/0.986/0.992/0.996 (corrected vector covers months 1-12). ERROR 2 (logic): the factor is valid only for a constant member base. If the workbook multiplies members(t) x steady-state GMV per member x ramp(launch month), 2027 H2 is overstated, because members who join after launch start their own ramps. With steady member growth g, the long-run factor is sum r(k)(1+g)^-k / sum r(k): about 0.83-0.87 at g=10%/month and 0.73-0.79 at g=20%/month. The plan's path to 330k by Dec 2027 implies double-digit monthly growth. Apply the ramp by member-join cohort, or multiply by this growth discount. The awareness ramp (0.70/0.85/0.95) is an unsourced assumption. Recharge's subscriber base likely retains better than a general mall's buyers.

I opened all three KOSTAT PDFs and read Table 1-1. The 2026-09-01 release (p.13) confirms 음·식료품 2025 monthly 32,388/28,401/31,002/30,676/31,157/30,381/32,396/32,262/36,364/30,537/32,218/32,630 (total 380,411), 2024.7-12 and 2026.1-7 (6-7p). The 2026-01-02 release (p.13) confirms 2024.1-6 = 29,547/26,107/28,139/27,971/29,218/27,185 and 2023 quarters 71,984/73,487/79,538/77,261. The 2025-02-04 release (p.26, titled '2024년 12월 및 연간 온라인쇼핑동향') confirms the 2023 monthly values exactly. I re-ran the method: scale to the latest quarterly totals, centered 2x12 MA, average by calendar month, normalize. Result [1.067,0.940,1.009,0.991,1.013,0.956,1.000,1.028,1.078,0.959,0.983,0.976], with per-year Jan 1.089/1.067/1.045, Sep 1.066/1.041/1.124 and Feb 0.951/0.928, all an exact match. Logic flag: the low/high brackets are inverted on retention. Recharge (86.6% at order 2) is the HIGHEST retention and sits in 'low'. 모노랩스 80% sits in 'high' but is lower than Recharge. Source note: 건강기능식품협회 '2024 건강기능식품 시장 현황 및 소비자 실태조사 보고서'. Caveats: the chart does not say whether shares are by value or purchase count, so the unit '% of purchases' is an interpretation. The 2024 report most likely reflects 2023 purchases.

verdicts.corrected_recommended: Use mild seasonality and renormalize to annual totals, or allocate flat (the pooled index stays within 0.94-1.08, so monthly error is at most about 8%). For 2027, prefer the 2027-calendar (2024-analog) index. It puts Aug 2027 at +3.6% and Sep 2027 (추석 9/15, launch month 3) at +3.6%, not +8%. Jan is the main peak (+8%) and Feb the trough (-5%). Apply seasonality to the cohort- and growth-adjusted ramp (see commerce_ramp_6m), not to members x steady GMV.
verdicts.note: Confirmed: peak-to-trough 1.078/0.940 = +14.7% (about 15%), and the Jul-Dec share with the pooled index = 50.19% vs 50.0% flat. Coupang Ads (2024-04-09) confirms '3월~5월 봄, 가정의 달 ... 매출이 집중 상승' and '추석이 껴있는 8월~9월에 매출이 집중 상승'. ERROR: the '+8% in Sep 2027' figure uses the pooled index. That Sep value (1.078) is lifted by 2025, when 추석 was Oct 6 and buying piled into late Sep. The 2027-calendar variant the same research recommends gives Sep 1.036 (Aug 1.036), so the uplift is about +3.5%, split across Aug and Sep. The Jan 2028 설 peak is plausible (설 2028 is Jan 26), but that date was not sourced. Note also that the 50.2% H2 share is irrelevant for 2027, when commerce runs only Jul-Dec.

check.overall: I opened every cited source again. I read the three KOSTAT PDFs (Table 1-1 on p.13/p.13/p.26), and Nasmedia p.4 as a rendered image. All sourced numbers match the sources, and I found no missing or invented URLs. I re-ran both derivations. The seasonal indices reproduce exactly. The 4-case cohort ramp reproduces to ±0.001. Two items need correction. (1) commerce_ramp_6m: months 1-6 are right, but 'month 8 onward is 1.0' is wrong. Months 7-12 run 0.95/0.97/0.98/0.99/0.99/1.00. The bigger problem is how the factor gets applied: it is valid only for a constant member base. With the planned member growth to 330k by Dec 2027 (double-digit % a month), members x steady GMV x ramp overstates H2 2027. The growth discount is about 0.83-0.87 at 10%/month and about 0.73-0.79 at 20%/month. Apply the ramp by member-join cohort. (2) seasonality_recommendation: Sep 2027 uplift is about +3.6% under the 2027-calendar index, not +8%. Minor source issues: the 필리 profile is dated 2022-07-13, not undated. The 닥터다이어리 13% and 필리 20-30% growth figures name no metric and predate 2023, so they are weak cross-checks. In repeat_buildup the low/high brackets are inverted: Recharge is the highest retention but is labelled low. Recharge covers subscribers only, which likely overstates general-mall retention. LEGAL/STRUCTURE FLAGS (from general knowledge; not verified against sources in this check): (a) The ramp and seasonality apply to GMV. Commerce revenue should be gross only for 직매입 (principal). For 통신판매중개/marketplace sales, revenue is the commission (agent, K-IFRS 15). Peer 'sales' figures such as 캐시딜 may be 거래액, not 매출. (b) Selling 건강기능식품 online needs 건강기능식품 일반판매업 신고 and 통신판매업 신고, and ads are subject to 자율심의. Tying AI 주치의 or 검진 results to product recommendations risks disease-efficacy advertising violations and 의료법 issues. (c) Using 검진 or insurance-DB health data (민감정보) for product marketing needs separate consent under 개인정보보호법 (민감정보 and marketing consents). (d) Paying hospital or pharmacy subscribers for product sales or referrals raises 의료법/약사법 rebate and patient-inducement risk. Cashback or points offered to 현대해상 insured members may raise 보험업법 특별이익 issues. (e) Subscription auto-billing is subject to the 2025 전자상거래법 amendments on recurring-payment notice and dark patterns, so reorder-retention assumptions should not rely on silent renewals.

topics.summary:
Core 청구SW is cheap and sticky. 의사랑 costs 가입비 100만원 plus 9만원/월, and 유팜 is 5만원/월 basic (FY2025 DART). UBcare serves about 17,800 병·의원 and 8,200 약국. 약정원's share slips only about 1pp a year.

New clinical add-ons ramp at different speeds:
- 딥카스 (paid hospital AI): 40 billing hospitals at 13 months, 60 at 17.
- 닥터팔레트 (cloud EMR): about 50 의원 at 18 months.
- 니어닥 (AI chart): 400+ 병·의원 in about 2 months, over 50% paid, MRR 1,230만원 (about 3-6만원 per clinic, my estimate).
- 실손24 (free, rolled out through EMR vendors): 6.9% to 26.2% of 의원·약국 in 5 months, then only +0.6pp a month.

Promotions: 의사랑 AI is free until end-2026. Rival pharmacy software offers 2개월-2년 fee waivers.

My recommended ramp: pilots signed during the Oct-Dec 2026 prep convert in January (8% of year-end), then climb steadily to 100% in December. That averages 5.84 paid months per year-end institution (low 4.68, high 7.52).

Counts: 200 의원 and 200 약국 (0.6% and 0.8% of the market) are plausible if sold through EMR-vendor integration. 200 병원급 hospitals would be aggressive.

Fees: 50만원/월 is 5.6x the leading EMR and 8-16x AI-chart revenue per clinic. It only holds up if bundled with patient flow (검진/보험 leads). A pure-SaaS price would be about 10-20만원. 약국 20만원 is 4x 유팜 and 1.33x 팜인사이트 (15만원), so it is at the upper edge.

items.label: Monthly paid-institution ramp factors, Jan..Dec 2027 (share of Dec-2027 paid count active in month)
items.derivation: OWN DERIVATION, not a sourced series. No Korean filing discloses monthly paid counts for a clinical add-on in its first 12 months, so the curve is built from these benchmarks: (a) Paid hospital AI SaaS (딥카스) adds institutions roughly linearly, about 3-5 per month: 40 billing hospitals at ~13 months, 60 at ~17, 83 at ~20, 95 at ~24. (b) An AI chart add-on for 의원 (니어닥, 2026) signed 400+ 병·의원 in about 2 months with >50% paid conversion, so demand for AI add-ons can be front-loaded. (c) 실손24 (free, vendor-gated) went from 6.9% before launch to 26.2% at +5 months, then slowed to +0.6pp a month; integration capacity caps later growth. (d) Onboarding is limited by installation throughput (PM+20: about 500 pharmacies a month even under a mandate). Recommended case: pilots recruited during the Oct-Dec 2026 prep convert to paid in Jan 2027 (8% of year-end), then a steady climb that speeds up slightly as sales capacity grows. Sum of factors: recommended 5.84 (average 0.487), low 4.68, high 7.52. Illustration: 200 병원 x 50만원 x 5.84 = 5.84억원; 200 약국 x 20만원 x 5.84 = 2.34억원. For the 50 검진센터 (enterprise contracts, and 검진 revenue starts in April), use the low curve or start at 0 until March.

verdicts.note: Own derivation, clearly labeled, and the arithmetic checks out. The factors sum to 5.84 (recommended), 4.68 (low) and 7.52 (high). The illustrations are right: 200 x 500,000 x 5.84 = 5.84억 and 200 x 200,000 x 5.84 = 2.336억. 8% of 200 = 16 pilots converting in January. I re-opened every benchmark. 딥카스: 비급여 billing from 2022-08-01 (청년의사 2022-06-24); 40 by August 2023 (팜뉴스); 60 at end-2023, 83 in March 2024, 95 in July 2024 (머니투데이 2024-08-01). That is about 3.3 a month in year 1 and about 5 a month after, so '3-5/month' holds. August 2023 is about 12 months after billing began, not 13. 니어닥: 'launched in May, 400+ 병·의원 in about two months, paid conversion 50% or more, MRR 1,230만원' (유니콘팩토리 via 네이트, 2026-08-05). 실손24: 6.9% (6,630) as of 2025-10-21, before the 2025-10-25 phase-2 launch (데일리팜 2025-10-23); 26.2% (25,472) as of 2026-04-01 (데일리팜 2026-04-15); 의원·약국 26.8% as of 2026-05-06, and the article's 'up only 0.6%p from a month earlier' (더퍼블릭 2026-05-12). That quote refers to the overall rate (29%), but 의원·약국 also rose 26.2 -> 26.8, so '+0.6pp a month' is consistent. PM+20: about 500 by end-January 2026, about 3,000 in six months. That was a forced migration after the vendor ended PIT3000, not a legal mandate, so 'even under a mandate' overstates it. Caveats: the curve does not say whether it is net of churn (churn_benchmark suggests 1%/month), and the 딥카스/바이탈케어 benchmarks are MFDS-approved SaMD that hospitals can bill patients for (비급여). A plain SaaS subscription has no such patient billing, so hospital-segment adoption could be slower.

All three facts are in the sources. (1) 닥터팔레트: 'apply online for a trial account and try it free for a week' (메디게이트뉴스 2023-09-05). (2) 의사랑 AI officially launched on the 6th, with 'a launch promotion giving all 의사랑 AI features free until end-2026' (약사공론 2026-08-06). That is about 4.8 months, and no post-promotion price is disclosed. The rename 유비케어 -> GC메디아이 was confirmed separately (sources say the name change was put to the 2026-03-24 AGM). (3) 약국: rival vendors promise 'fee waivers of at least 2 months and up to 2 years' (데일리팜 2026-06-05). Recommended 2 is the researcher's own pick and is reasonable. Logic nit: the item calls this a 'sourced range' but caps the high at 5 months, while the pharmacy source's maximum is 24 months. For the 약국 segment the sourced high should be 24. Also, those waivers are for switching core claim software during the PIT3000 end-of-life, not for AI add-ons.

유비케어 제32기 사업보고서 (KRX KIND, 2026-03-16), price table. 의사랑: '가입비 1백만원 + 월회비 9만원', the same for 제30-32기, switching after 3 years to maintenance fees of 월 6만원 or 8.4만원. 유팜: 제32기 '월회비 5만원(기본) 월회비 4만원(추가)'; 제30-31기 '월회비 4만원(기본/추가)'. [90000, 50000] is correct. Suggestion: the 의원 low could be 60,000 (post-3-year maintenance fee) rather than 90,000.

니어닥 facts are verbatim in 유니콘팩토리 (2026-08-05): 400+ 병·의원, 'paid conversion 50% or more', 'MRR 1,230만원'. The article gives no price. Derivations are correct: 12,300,000 / 200 = 61,500 and 12,300,000 / 400 = 30,750. Both 400 and 50% are lower bounds, so 61,500 is a ceiling on revenue per paid clinic, which is labeled correctly as the upper figure. 크레소티 팜인사이트 (pharmacist AI CRM) costs '15만원 a month' (데일리팜 2026-06-02). The article only said official open was scheduled for July (예정), so the July launch itself is not confirmed there.

Arithmetic is correct: 500,000 / 90,000 = 5.56; 500,000 / 61,500 = 8.1; 500,000 / 30,750 = 16.3; 200,000 / 50,000 = 4.0; 200,000 / 150,000 = 1.33. 강남언니: '유료 입점병원 800곳' and 2020 revenue '120억원' (신아일보 2021-10-05), so 12,000,000,000 / 800 / 12 = 1,250,000 a month. The periods don't match (800 is the Oct-2021 count, 120억 is 2020 revenue), and 강남언니 is a 비급여 advertising platform, so it is a weak anchor. The low/high vectors mix two different methods (a fee cut for 병원 vs a different benchmark for 약국), so treat them as illustrative. LEGAL FLAG: the conclusion that 50만원 is 'plausible only if bundled with measurable patient/lead flow (검진 referrals, 보험 DB)' is risky. 의료법 제27조 제3항 bans for-profit patient introduction or referral (환자 소개·알선·유인), and fees that scale with patients or leads delivered can be treated as brokerage consideration. Keep hospital fees flat (SaaS or advertising under 의료광고 rules), not per lead or per booking. Supplying 보험 DB to hospitals also raises 개인정보보호법 third-party-provision consent issues and insurance-solicitation (보험업법 모집) limits. For 약국, 'commerce or 건기식 revenue share' must not be tied to prescriptions or dispensing (약사법 알선·담합 prohibitions), and the platform must not take part in running the pharmacy. This needs legal review before any bundle pricing goes into the workbook.

Arithmetic is correct: 200 / 34,958 = 0.572% and 200 / 23,697 = 0.844%. Bases verified. 메디게이트뉴스 (2023-04-26) gives 34,958 의원 nationwide as of March 2023; 데일리팜 (2025-07-01) gives 23,697 pharmacies as of Dec 2024. Both are stale for 2027 and should be refreshed from HIRA. Comparators verified: 굿팜 launched early Feb 2021 after testing in about 40 pharmacies, targeting 2,000 that year (의약뉴스 2021-03-04), and grew '750 -> 1,500여곳 over the last 3 years' (약사공론 2025-03-24). The ≈2022 date for 750 is derived. LOGIC PROBLEM: 바로팜 파마시뷰티존 is 'a beauty shelf (매대) setup business inside pharmacies', a merchandising and distribution deal, not software. The article doesn't say whether pharmacies pay. It is not a valid SaaS adoption comparator and should be dropped. Its facts are correct: 100 in August, 200+ announced on the 10th (팜뉴스 2026-09-10). 니어닥 '200+ paid' is derived from two lower bounds. The 병원급 caution (딥카스 60 at end-2023) is supported.

Mostly assumption, and labeled as such. Proxy facts verified: 약정원 share '2023년 45.4%, 2024년 44.1%, 2025년 43.5%' (데일리팜 2025-07-01); UBcare network 17,800 병·의원 / 8,200 약국 (FY2025 사업보고서); 유투바이오 제15기 (FY2023) report citing 유비케어's '17,700여 개의 병원ㆍ의원, 8,000여개의 약국'. Arithmetic: 1.3 / 45.4 = 2.9% and 0.6 / 44.1 = 1.4%. That is roughly 1.4-2.9% a year, which works out to about 0.12-0.25% a month, not 'about 0.25%'. The low of 0.25 is the top of the proxy range. 1%/month = 11.4%/year is correct. Logic caveat: share drift and a flat installed base measure net relative change, not logo churn (the source says new pharmacies prefer private vendors, so share loss partly reflects new openings). 니어닥's conversion rate is not a churn measure. High 3% is unsourced and labeled as such.

'유료 전환율은 50% 이상을 기록' is verbatim in 유니콘팩토리 via 네이트 (2026-08-05). Because the source says 'or more', 50 is a floor, and the high of 60 is the researcher's labeled assumption. Funnel arithmetic is correct: 16 paid / 0.5 = 32 pilots, with 16 = 8% x 200. Caveat: 니어닥 converted through self-serve sign-ups with no ads or marketing (per the article). Enterprise or pilot conversion for hospitals and 검진센터 may differ.

All five counts are in the sources. 40: 'the year-end target of 40 was reached in August; target raised to 60' (팜뉴스, updated 2023-08-31). 60: 'end of last year 60곳 (incl. 11 상급종합병원)', 83: 'March (83곳)', 95: 'as of July, 95 in total incl. 17 상급종합병원' (머니투데이 2024-08-01). 70: 'billing and contracts completed at about 70 hospitals in total', 10+ new contracts and 3,500+ new billing beds in January 2024, and 28,000+ billing beds in total (뷰노 2024-01-30). The 70 figure mixes billing and contracted hospitals, which the item flags. Months since the 2022-08-01 billing start are about 12/16/17/19/23 (the item says 13/17/18/20/24, off by one). The 3-5 a month pace is correct.

바이오타임즈 (2025-04-21): entered the 비급여 market in March 2023; billing hospitals 100+ with about 45,000 beds as of April 2025; 2024 revenue about 100억원. March 2023 to April 2025 is about 25 months, and 100 / 25 = 4 a month is correct. 100 is a floor ('100곳↑').

닥터팔레트: '도입 at about 50 의원 in Korea' (메디게이트뉴스 2023-03-09), and 'from September 2021 to now, 150 의원' (메디게이트뉴스 2023-09-05). That is about 18 and 24 months after launch. 비트플러스 launched in 2020 ('지난해') and had 'already landed at about 20 개원가 sites less than a year after launch' (메디칼타임즈 2021-04-05). All pre-2023 sourcing is flagged. The 'paid' label is supported for 닥터팔레트 (fees charged per hospital, no install or sign-up fee).

Counts verified: 'from about 360 early this year to about 900 as of end-March' (아시아경제 2022-04-06); 'partner 병·의원 and 약국 passed 3,000' and 'about 700 partners in Q1 last year' (헤럴드경제 2023-03-08). The two sources differ for Q1 2022 (900 vs 700). UNSUPPORTED qualifiers: neither cited article gives the launch date (Dec 2020), so '13 months after launch' is unverified, and neither says partnership was free (Herald: terms not disclosed). Use these counts only as a qualitative upper bound during the COVID telemedicine surge.

'About 500 pharmacies completed conversion', as of end of last month, with support starting last month, i.e. January 2026 (데일리팜 2026-02-07). 'About 3,000 converted to PM+20 within half a year', conversion rate in the 50% range, original end of June (데일리팜 2026-06-05). Deadline moved to December, 'the number of pharmacies that can be processed per day is limited', and the free conversion vendor list expanded (약사공론 2026-06-23). 3,000 / 6 = 500 a month is correct. topics.summary: Evidence says new insurance lead channels in Korea start slowly and do most of their first-year volume late in the year. FSC 보험 비교·추천: about 6,100 contracts in month 1 (Jan-Feb 2024) against 280k over 14 months, and the weekly daily average rose from 161 to 264 in the first 4 weeks. 토스보험파트너: 5,800 consultations in beta, 700k in its first 10 months, then about 520k a month by Oct 2021. Applying P1/P2/P3 to our plan (300-lead 강남 pilot, then 7 수도권 지역단 at about 55% of volume since 수도권 is 50.8% of population, nationwide from late Aug, members growing to 330k) gives factors Apr..Dec = 0.02/0.04/0.14/0.24/0.40/0.61/0.77/0.90/1.00, adding to about 4.1 of the Dec run-rate. To reach 120,000 in 2027, Dec supply would need about 29k/month, which is 8.8% of 330k members every month. That is about 3.3x Toss's peak ratio (about 2.7%/month). So 120k is not plausible. We recommend planning about 30k (range 14k-55k). Price: 금감원 consumer alert (2026-07) says DB sold to GAs at 5만-13만원 per person. Press puts consult-consented DB at 6만-8만원 and DB with a booked consultation at 15만-20만원. Our 5만원 sits at the low end. The 10만원 tier will not apply in 2027. Before paid supply, these gates must be cleared: fees cannot be 모집 대가 unless we register as a GA (보험업법 §99①); 개인정보보호법 §17② notice items plus separate consent for health data (§23); 금소법 §22 advertising and 광고심의 risk; and 현대해상 due diligence on the DB vendor, now tighter after the 2026-09-11 PIPA change and the 금감원 inspection of 70 GAs. No 혁신금융 sandbox is needed unless we compare or recommend products.

items.label: Monthly supply factors Apr..Dec 2027 (share of Dec-2027 national matured run-rate S)
items.derivation: DERIVED. Timeline from our design report: P1 runs Apr 1 to May 26, with 2 weeks of prep and 6 weeks of operation in 강남, capped at 300 leads (about 50 a week, so about 115 in Apr and 185 in May). P2 runs May 27 to Aug 18 across 7 수도권 지역단. P3 goes nationwide from Aug 19. Factor = coverage x maturity x member index. Coverage: 수도권 is treated as 0.55 of volume, a little above its 50.8% population share because health-platform members skew toward 수도권. Maturity for a newly opened region: 0.5 in month 1, 0.75 in month 2, 0.9 in month 3, 1.0 after that. This follows the FSC weekly ramp, where the week-1 daily average was 53% and week 4 was 87% of the 7-month average. Member index assumes linear growth from open to 330k at year-end (m/12). Apr and May come from the P1 absolute cap at S of about 7,300, plus the first 5 days of P2 in May. The factors add up to about 4.12. Coverage-only variant, if member growth is modeled elsewhere: 0.02, 0.04, 0.28, 0.41, 0.59, 0.82, 0.93, 0.98, 1.00.

items.label: What must be in place before paid DB supply to 현대해상 starts (Apr 2027)
items.recommended: 1) Fee structure: 보험업법 §99① bars insurers from paying 모집 fees to anyone who is not a licensed seller, so the fee must be a per-DB or marketing-service fee that is not tied to contracts. The alternative is registering a GA, the route taken by 토스인슈어런스, 뱅크샐러드 (GA subsidiary, Jul 2025) and 삼쩜삼 (GA registered, 2026). 2) Consent: 개인정보보호법 §17② requires naming the recipient (현대해상), purpose, items, retention, and the right to refuse. Health data is 민감정보 and needs a separate §23 consent; safest is to pass only contact details and stated interest, not checkup results. 3) Screens and ads: a recommendation of a specific product is 중개 (FSC 2021-09-07). Wording implying enrollment or financial planning can make it a 금소법 업무광고, so copy should go through 현대해상 준법감시인 and 손보협회 광고심의. 4) Vendor due diligence at 현대해상: collection-path legality, liability and damages clauses, registration in its central PI system. Scrutiny tightened after the 2026-07-01 금감원 consumer alert, the Sep-Oct 2026 inspection of 70 GAs, and the PIPA amendment effective 2026-09-11. 5) No 혁신금융 designation is needed for single-insurer lead supply. It would be needed for multi-insurer comparison or recommendation; in the 2023-24 cycle, designation (2023-07) to launch (2024-01-19) took about 6 months.

verdicts.note: All 3 cited sources opened (2026-09-15) and match. FSC 81740: users about 12만, contracts about 6,100 as of 2024-02-19; weekly daily averages 161/215/247/264. Newspim 2024-09-10 has the 67만 users and 305/day figures, but the period is '1월부터 8월8일까지' and it covers '자동차보험과 해외여행보험 등', not auto only. 정책브리핑 2025-07-29 has the 50.8% (2,631만) figure. The P1/P2/P3 inputs match the internal report docs/lead_routing/현대해상_리드라우팅_설계보고서.md: P1 is 8주 (준비 2주 + 운영 6주) with 300 leads in 강남지역단, P2 is 12주 across 7 수도권 지역단, P3 is 16 지역단 nationwide. The derivation is labeled and recomputes within 0.01: Apr 114/7,300 = 0.016; Jun 0.55x0.5x6/12 = 0.14; Aug (0.55x0.92 + 0.45x0.21)x8/12 = 0.40; Sep 0.61; Oct 0.76; Nov 0.89; Dec 1.00. Sum 4.12. 161/305 = 0.53 and 264/305 = 0.87 are correct. Caveats: (1) Starting P1 on Apr 1 assumes P0 and the Go gate in the report are done before April. (2) Apr and May are circular: they are computed at S = 7,300. At S = 29,100 they would be about 0.004 and 0.011. (3) 0.55 for 수도권 and linear member growth are assumptions. (4) The 305/day base includes travel and pet products added in July 2024. (5) In the coverage-only variant, Oct recomputes to about 0.92, not 0.93.

The arithmetic is right: 6,100 / (280k / 13.4 months = 20.9k) = 0.29. The interpretation is flawed. 정책브리핑 2025-03-24 shows 약 185만건 used and 약 28만건 contracts for all 5 products over 2024-01 to 2025-02: 자동차 and 용종 (Jan 2024), 저축 (Jun 2024), 펫 and 여행자 (Jul 2024). Newspim's 305/day also includes 해외여행보험. So most of the later volume (about 218k in Aug 2024 to Feb 2025, about 1,070/day) comes from products added later, not a maturing launch. A like-for-like ratio is month-1 daily of about 190 (6,100 over 32 days) against the Jan-to-Aug-8 average of 305, which gives about 0.63. Low and high are also different measures: 0.22 is a share of the 14-month total, and 0.53 is week 1 against the 7-month average. A consistent range is 0.53-0.87 (weeks 1-4 against 305). Other checks: 203 days x 305 = 61.9k (correct); the FSC 2024-01-18 release confirms 7 platforms at launch. The claim that the FSC service was 'strongly back-loaded' is weaker than stated.

뉴스토마토 2020-08-14 confirms the beta ran '지난 6월부터', with about 2,300 설계사 and 5,800여건 of consultations. 토스피드 2021-05-24: '지난 10개월 간 ... 보험 상담 건수는 70만건을 넘어섰다' and '토스의 1900만 사용자'. 디지털투데이 2021-10-18: '상담이 연결된 건수는 10월 현재까지 누적 320만건'. Derived figures recompute: 70k/month; 2.5M over about 4.8 months = 520k/month (7.4x); 70k/19M = 0.37%; 520k/19M = 2.7%. The two counts use different measures, 상담 건수 vs 상담이 연결된 건수 (one request can connect to several 설계사). The 7x jump and the 2.7% ratio may therefore be overstated. The gap list already notes this; treat the ratio as indicative only.

Arithmetic is correct: 120,000/4.12 = 29,126; 29,126/330,000 = 8.8%; 8.8/2.74 = 3.2x; 8.8/0.37 = 24x. The 1900만 users figure is in the 토스피드 source. The coverage-only variant sums to 5.07 (S about 23.7k, 7.2% of members), which fits 'at or below about 5'. Caveat: the Toss 2.7% benchmark rests on a mixed counting basis (see toss_partner_ramp), so read the 3.3x multiple as an order of magnitude.

The derivation is labeled and the arithmetic holds: 3,300x4.12 = 13.6k; 7,260x4.12 = 29.9k; 330k x 2.7% x 1.5 = 13,365, x4.12 = 55.1k. The 1% (low) and 2.2% (mid) rates are unsourced assumptions. Only the 2.7% high anchor comes from a source. 디지털타임스 2026-04-27 gives 한화손보 at 1만3982명 and says '지난해에는 현대해상도 제쳤다', so 현대해상 was below 13,982 in 2025; no 현대해상 count is given. The 아주경제 2026-07-20 allocation is 삼성화재 TC지점, 30 a month in year 1 only, falling to 20 and 10 (720 over 3 years). 30,000/30 = 1,000 설계사 is correct. The 100k-case threshold matches the internal plan: scripts/invest/adjust.py hmCap1 = 100,000, 우대 단가 = 시가 10만 x 50% = 5만, and cases above the cap are priced at 시가.

Arithmetic matches adjust.py, where 우대 단가 is 5만 up to 10만 건 and 시가 is 10만 above it. Plan: 100k x 5만 (50억) + 20k x 10만 (20억) = 70억. The other figures check: 30k -> 15억; 13.6k -> 6.8억 (about 7억); 55k -> 27.5억. The cited KPI뉴스 article has no bearing on these figures; it is pricing context only. Revenue is gross, before collection lag and any VAT treatment.

머니투데이 2026-07-01: 'DB업체가 개인정보를 1인당 5만~13만원에 GA에 판매하는 사례도 있다', within its 금감원 consumer-alert coverage. 보험매일 2026-07-01: '보험 가입 의사 여부 등을 확인한 개인정보를 1인당 5만~13만원 수준에 GA에 판매하는 사례도 확인'. KPI뉴스 2026-09-08: '상담에 동의한 DB는 건당 6만∼8만 원' and '상담 일정까지 잡힌 DB는 15만∼20만 원 선'. 보험저널 2026-07-28: '수만원에서 10만원을 넘는 수준'. Three corrections to the wording. (1) 5만 is below the 6만-8만 consented band; it is the floor of the 금감원 5만-13만 range, not 'the bottom of the consented band'. (2) The 5만-13만 figures describe cases from an alert about deceptively collected DB sold to GAs; they are not insurer-procurement prices. (3) The 2019-2021 reference points carry no source and should be dropped.

KPI뉴스 2026-09-08 states verbatim '상담 일정까지 잡힌 DB는 15만∼20만 원 선'. The same article has a buyer paying 7만원 per DB for 20 leads, reaching fewer than 10 people, with zero contracts. Useful as a quality warning.

FSC 84721 (2025-06-02) confirms '④보험대리점 소속 설계사 1,200% 규칙 적용: 26.7월' and '①설계사 판매수수료 분급: 27.1월(27~28년 4년분급, 29.1월~ 7년 분급)'. It also confirms the 선지급 cap: '계약체결비용의 100% 이내'. The derivation is wrong to say a 7-year maintenance commission is added from Jan 2027: 2027-2028 uses 4-year 분급 and 7-year runs from 2029-01. The quote in the sources field is a paraphrase, not verbatim. 보험저널 32376 confirms that DB given free counts as '모집활동을 지원하는 경제적 이익'. Externally bought DB is valued at 실제 구입가격; self-owned DB uses cost allocation (ads, platform, staff divided by valid DB). The direction of the argument (downward price pressure) still holds.

verdicts.corrected_recommended: 1) Before Apr 2027, get a written legal opinion (ideally a 금융위 법령해석 or 비조치의견서) that the 헬스메이트센터 사용료 is not a §99① 모집 대가; otherwise use the GA route. Renaming 보험 중개 수수료 to 사용료 or 시스템사용료+광고료 does not change the substance. Price must not vary with conversions or contracts. Separately review the investment-linked 우대 단가. 2) PIPA: §17② five notice items naming 현대해상; §22①7호 separate consent for 판매 권유 purposes; §22⑤ no refusal of membership services to members who decline; §23 separate consent if any health data or disease interest is passed. If insurance or coverage data (보장맵) is included, check 신용정보법 provision rules. 3) Keep screens away from recommending specific products (FSC 2021-09-07) and from wording that implies contracting or 중개 (FSC 2022-06-24). Put ad copy through 현대해상 준법감시인 and association 광고심의. 4) 현대해상 vendor due diligence: collection path and legality, consent procedure, liability and damages clauses, tighter after the 2026-07-01 금감원 alert, the Sep 2026 inspection of about 70 large GAs, and the 2026-09-11 CEO-accountability change. 5) No sandbox is needed only if the activity is not 중개. If it is, registration (GA) is required, not an exemption.
verdicts.note: Confirmed against sources: §99① text ('모집할 수 있는 자 이외의 자에게 ... 수수료, 보수, 그 밖의 대가를 지급하지 못한다'); §17② five items; §23 '별도로 동의'; FSC 2021-09-07 ('판매를 목적으로 하는 경우는 일반적으로 중개'); FSC 2022-06-24 (misleading wording -> '업무광고로 볼 여지'); 보험저널 2021-05-26 (전건 광고심의); 중앙이코노미뉴스 2026-09-01 ('소속 설계사 500명 이상 대형 GA 70여 곳', inspection from Sep, 제재심 late Sep to Oct); 보험저널 2026-09-03 ('9월 11일부터 개인정보 보호 CEO 총괄 관리책임 강화'); 보험저널 2026-02-26 ('수집 경로와 적법성', contract and damages clauses); FSC 2024-01-18 (designated 2023-07, launched 2024-01-19); 인사이트코리아 2026-08-27 (뱅크샐러드 GA subsidiary 2025-07, 삼쩜삼 GA registration 2026). Unsupported: 'registration in its central PI system' has no source. The 금소법 §22 article number was not re-fetched. Legal-structure problems: (a) The FSC 2021-09-07 guidance treats product recommendation as '잠재고객 발굴 및 가입유도', part of selling, and treats a platform paid by 판매실적 as 중개. Consented-lead supply meant for 현대해상 sales is at real risk of being judged 모집 or 중개, whatever the fee is called. Internal gen_budget.py already notes the IM settlement is '법률검토 전제'. (b) The research's 'per-DB fee not tied to contracts' route has no primary source (the research admits this). (c) PIPA §22⑤, checked on casenote, bars making marketing or third-party consent a condition of membership. That caps opt-in and supports a low ramp. (d) The 'no sandbox needed' judgment leaves out that the alternative to a sandbox is GA registration, not freedom from regulation.

정책브리핑 2023-04-06 states '자동차보험의 보험료 대비 수수료 한도는 4%대로 제한한다' (supports high = 4). 블로터 2025-04-22 has 'PM채널 수수료(약 1.5%)', '0.4%에 불과', and '구매전환율은 9.2%'. It presents 1.5% as a cost that squeezes insurer margins, not as an 'industry standard'. The claim that the government said about 3% was passed on to consumers in version 1.0 appears in neither cited source; unsupported, remove it. Keep 1.5 (low) and 4 (cap) as context only; this is a per-contract fee, not a per-lead price.

인사이트코리아 2026-07-14 confirms '현재 약 3200명의 설계사에게 하루 2건씩 고객DB를 지원'. 3,200x2 = 6,400/day is correct. Problems in the derivation: (1) About 130k/month assumes about 20 working days; on calendar days it is about 192k, so give a 128k-192k range. (2) '20M+ user base' is not in the cited source. (3) 'After about 6 years' is wrong for 토스인슈어런스. 인사이트코리아 2026-08-27 says it '2022년 2월 설계사 2명으로 대면 영업을 시작', about 4.4 years before Jul 2026. The 6 years fits only 토스보험파트너 (2020). The conclusion that 120k/year equals about 1 month of Toss flow roughly holds (0.6-0.9 months).

check.overall: I reopened all 25 cited URLs (2026-09-15) and each one loaded; the quoted figures exist. The derivation arithmetic (factor sum 4.12, S = 29.1k, 13.6k/30k/55k volumes, 70억/15억 revenue) recomputes correctly. It also matches the internal lead-routing report (P1 8주 with 300 leads, P2 12주 across 7 수도권 지역단) and adjust.py (5만 우대 단가 up to 10만 건, 시가 10만 above). Corrections: (1) launch_backloading_fsc. The 28만 contracts cover 5 products, several added mid-2024, so 0.29 mixes product expansion with launch maturation. A like-for-like month-1 ratio is about 0.63, and the low and high bounds measure different things. (2) price_pressure. 2027-01 starts 4-year 분급; 7-year 분급 only from 2029-01. (3) platform_fee. The '3% passed on to consumers' claim is not in any cited source. (4) platform_lead_scale_toss. Monthly flow is 128k-192k depending on day basis; '6 years' and '20M+ users' are not supported (Toss Insurance's own GA sales began 2022-02). (5) regulatory_gate. 'Central PI system registration' has no source. Legal-structure flags: FSC 2021-09-07 treats lead-finding and 가입유도 as part of selling, and performance-based platform fees as 중개. The plan's renaming of 보험 중개 수수료 to 헬스메이트센터 사용료 does not cure the 보험업법 §99① risk. It needs a written legal opinion or 비조치의견서, or the GA route, before paid supply in Apr 2027. PIPA §22①7호 and §22⑤ require separate marketing consent and bar making it a condition of membership, which caps opt-in. 신용정보법 may apply if insurance or coverage data is shared. The core finding that 120k in 2027 is implausible under P1/P2/P3 gating holds as a labeled derivation. The 1%/2.2% member lead rates remain unsourced assumptions, and the Toss 2.7% benchmark mixes counting bases.

topics.summary: 대표 지시(2026-09-15)와 양식 판단 — 개시 월은 지시, 늘어나는 모양은 조사, 섞는 방식·보정은 양식 판단

items.label: 2026-10 본격 준비 · 2027-01-01 실제 오픈 · 연차 = 2027~2031 달력 연도
items.derivation: 대표 지시 2026-09-15 — 전체 예산표에 적용(준비기간 3개월: 인건비·광고·시스템 설치·메디에이지)

items.label: 매출 산정 방식 — 월별 누적(기본) vs 연말 기준
items.derivation: finModel 연간 매출은 연말 회원(연말 누적 동의·연말 유료 기관) × 연간 단가라 성장 연도에 월별로 쌓은 값보다 크다(2028 연말 130만 ← 2027 33만). 2027은 개시 시점을 넣으려면 월별 누적이 필요하고, 같은 기준을 2028~2031에도 쓰는 것이 기본. 1로 바꾸면 2028~2031은 사업계획서 방식.

items.label: 검진 계절 지수 = 국가 일반검진(검증 보정) 50% + 민간 종합검진 50%
items.derivation: 하이핀 검진 예약은 국가검진 도래 안내(메디에이지)와 기업·유료 종합검진이 섞이고, 제휴 센터의 12월 수용 한계가 있어 국가 수검 분포(12월 20%)를 그대로 쓰지 않음. 4분기 36%.

items.label: 커머스 개시 계수 — 재구매 램프에 회원 증가 코호트 보정
items.derivation: 검증자 지적: 상수 회원 기준 램프(0.28→0.92)를 늘어나는 회원에 그대로 곱하면 하반기를 과대계상. 월말 회원 경로(m1Ramp)로 월별 신규 코호트를 쌓아 두 재구매 곡선(Recharge·라플라스) × 인지 램프 유무 4가지를 평균 — 성장 할인 0.84~0.91.

items.label: 사용료 개시 계수 — 조사 계수에서 회원 증가 지수(m/12) 제거
items.derivation: 조사 계수 0.02~1.00은 커버리지 × 권역 성숙 × 회원 지수. 양식은 월 기준에 이미 월말 회원 비율이 있어 회원 지수를 나눠 뺌 → 2027 반영 약 3.8만 건(조사 적정 1.4만~5.5만 · 중간 3만).

items.label: 돌봄 매출 구조 — 센터당 월 정액 파트너 이용료(건당 소개료 아님)
items.derivation: 대표 지시 2026-09-14(회원 과금 없음)와 노인장기요양보험법 §35⑥(영리 목적 수급자 소개·알선·유인 금지) · 의료법 §27③ 판례(대법 2018도20928 수수료형 불법, 헌재 2017헌마327 정액 광고비)를 함께 반영. 센터 수는 수요로 추정하지만 요금은 건수와 무관 — 검증자는 실질이 건당으로 보일 수 있다고 지적(법률의견·비유료 센터 노출·광고 표기 필요).

items.label: 2028~2031 성숙 계수 — 커머스 0.84·0.88·0.91·0.93 · 돌봄 2028 0.93
items.derivation: 검증자 지적: 2027에만 코호트 보정을 넣으면 2028 커머스가 약 110억 크다. 2027과 같은 코호트 모형(월말 회원에 비례해 매달 구매 코호트 시작 · 재구매 곡선 2종 × 인지 램프 유무 평균)을 2031까지 돌려 연도별 (월말 회원 가중) 평균 계수를 넣음. 돌봄은 30%→12개월 100% 램프의 2028 잔여를 회원 가중 평균(0.935).

items.label: 구독 2028~ — 유형별 유료 기관 직선 경로
items.derivation: 검증자 지적: 월별 누적에서 구독을 회원 비율로 늘리면 2029년 1월 과금 기관이 전년 12월보다 적어지는 모순(기관 이탈 0 가정과 충돌). 검진센터·병원·약국별로 전년 말 유료 기관에서 연말까지 직선으로 늘리고 유형별 반영률(= 전년/연말 + (1 − 전년/연말) × 78/144)을 씀.

items.label: 법인세 — 이월결손금 2028부터 차감
items.derivation: 검증자 지적: 안내에 이월결손금이라 적었지만 2028 법인세는 전액 과세였음. 시나리오별 준비기간 비용(A 11.5억 · B·C 19.9억)과 연도 손실을 쌓아 이후 세전이익에서 차감(중소기업 공제 한도 100% 가정). 임차·채용 수수료(모델 밖 현금)는 과세표준에 넣지 않음.

items.label: B·C는 오픈 기준 기간 — 계절·한도 연차·C 미공급도 함께 민다
items.derivation: 검증자 지적: B·C는 계획 월 전체를 2개월 밀어 1차 = 2027-03~2028-02. 검진 계절을 달력에 고정하면 B·C 필요 총자금 +0.7억(요청액 그대로). C의 DB 미공급은 오픈 후 첫 12개월 — 달력 2027만으로 두면 C 130억.

gaps: 검진 예약 플랫폼·건강몰·병원 SaaS·보험 DB 모두 공개 월별 램프 데이터가 없어 개시 뒤 모양은 벤치마크 기반 가정이다 — 제휴 계약(센터 슬롯·EMR 연동·현대해상 파일럿)이 정해지면 바꾼다.
